svg.aria-label: The cover of GPU Architecture & Parallel Programming from First Principles, on a night-blue honeycomb. On the left the queen bee, in a crown, gives one order to her colony: c[i] = a[i] + b[i]. On the right stand 4 hornets, large and fast, each beside one big cell: the few strong cores of a CPU. Below, 32 worker bees in hard hats stand in 4 rows of 8 at their own honeycomb cells, one warp of the GPU, all filling their cells at the same moment. One bee in the third row has wandered off on a branch of its own, with a question mark over its head. A crab in a hard hat waves from the corner, because the book writes every program in CUDA C++ and in Rust.
